entries.source_evidence: Player said 'Continue the journey' at dawn Day268 after previously accepted wolf encounter, successful intimidation and qualifying wilderness overnight. On the established Crownsunder→legal western Veyr commercial road with V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar, intact coach and 4 healthy horses, ordinary daytime travel continues. Encounter-protection rule: Day266 trolls and Day267 wolves were two consecutive random encounter DAYS, so Day268 is a mandatory random-encounter quiet travel day, no Day268 day or night roll. Day268→269 roadside wilderness overnight peacefully completed and adds1 weighted Long Rest unit1/6→2/6; normal wilderness Short Rest completes for all, no HP/HD/spells/limited features spent. Day269 dawn normal once-per-day feeding for three eaters Mara/Cirren/Fenar and four horses: rations12→9 person-days, horse feed16→12 animal-days. Day269 ordinary trade-road daytime d100 FACE47 vs01–15 NO encounter; following exposed wilderness camp night d100 FACE35 vs01–07 NO encounter; genuine Python secrets executed both. Peaceful qualifying night269→270 completes wilderness Short Rest and weighted Long Rest2/6→3/6; no feature/spell/HP/HD changes beyond already-full Short Rest pools, no full Long Rest. Day270 dawn normal breakfast/feed one allocation: rations9→6, horse feed12→8. Day270 daytime ordinary road encounter d100 FACE80 vs01–15 NO encounter (genuine executed Python secrets). Late Day270 afternoon while still in Crownsunder and still before legal western Veyr crossing, party passes scattered low hills/farms and sees a small inhabited commercial road-side service settlement ahead, cluster of slate roofs, fenced wagon yard and stable signs. Exact official name, distance to frontier and whether a secure town rest applies are NOT established until actual arrival; no specific resident met, trade, fee, toll, purchase, border, accommodation or road arrival assumed. Coach/horses intact, V HP48/48 HD5/7 SecondWind1/1, Superiority4/4 ActionSurge1/1, Psi6/6 MP7/7, Fenar58/59 HD1/6 Rage2/4 Shift1/3, Cirren49/51 HD5/6 L1=0/4 L2=1/3 L3=2/3, Channel Divinity2/2. Long Rest progress3/6. Supplies now6 ration-person-days and8 horse-feed animal-days (two days at established daily rates). Late-afternoon Day270 next V choice: approach and resupply or lodge at settlement, continue along main road or otherwise; no new day/night check or rest yet. No unrelated quest event, initiative or treasure.
entries.pending_action: Day270 late afternoon on Crownsunder commercial road before western Veyr legal crossing. V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar with intact four-horse coach approach sight of a small ordinary roadside service settlement, not entered yet; no town rest, visit or payment established. V48/48 HD5/7 SecondWind1/1 Superiority4/4 ActionSurge1/1 Psi6/6 MP7/7, Fenar58/59 HD1/6 Rage2/4 Shift1/3, Cirren49/51 HD5/6 L1=0/4 L2=1/3 L3=2/3. Long Rest3/6; provisions6 ration-person-days, feed8 horse animal-days. No D270 night roll. V chooses whether approach/resupply/stay or continue.

entries.source_evidence: Player exact response at Day270 late-afternoon roadside settlement: "yes and resupply", accepting offer to stop for provisions and lodging. Party V, Mara, Cirren, Fenar enters an ordinary unnamed small permanently occupied Crownsunder trade-road village short of western Veyr crossing with shop, smith and staffed coaching inn/stables. No invented border arrival, new named NPC, quest or extraordinary merchant roll. Established V travel-provision targets are seven days for three eaters and four horses; before resupply carried six ration-person-days, eight horse-feed animal-days. Mundane supplies purchased: 15 ration-person-days at 5sp each=7gp5sp; 20 horse-feed animal-days at5cp each=1gp; goods now 21 ration-person-days and28 feed animal-days. User accepted overnight lodging as well: four modest beds at standard5sp each=2gp and one night's stabling for four horses at5sp each=2gp; two modest rooms arranged, staff takes ordinary custody/care of four healthy V horses, V coach parked in serviced yard, still V-owned. Purchase plus accommodation cost total12gp5sp, paid V personal purse once: 1150gp2sp6cp ->1137gp7sp6cp. No payment by estate or NPC. Mundane staff arrange goods and horses without special check, no extra magical purchase or inn meal charge; ordinary evening local elapsed time only, no overnight Short Rest or full Long Rest yet, no day271 supplies allocation, spell or HP restoration, and no encounter roll. V48/48 HP HD5/7 ActionSurge1/1 Superiority4/4 SecondWind1/1 Psi6/6 MP7/7; Fenar58/59 HD1/6 Rage2/4 Shift1/3; Cirren49/51 HD5/6 L1=0/4 L2=1/3 L3=2/3. Long Rest progress3/6 unchanged pending a qualifying quiet overnight. Player controls whether to retire, talk to companions, ask locals, or depart later.
